prompts.foliageAtlas: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original real-time 3D foliage cutout texture atlas. Create a square 2048x2048 PNG with TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA background: exactly four separate foliage branch clusters in an invisible 2 by 2 grid, each entirely contained within its quadrant with generous transparent padding around every edge and no overlap between cells. Top left: fresh Pacific Northwest bigleaf maple twig bearing five to seven recognizable large five-lobed maple leaves with visible veins, varied orientations, subtle greens. Top right: red alder twig bearing ten to fifteen small oval serrated green leaves. Bottom left: Douglas-fir branching spray, slender twigs densely edged with individual short fine evergreen needles, natural gaps between sprays. Bottom right: western redcedar branching spray with distinct flattened overlapping scale-leaf fans and delicately drooping tips. Each twig runs from lower middle toward upper middle within its cell, filling most of the usable cell; species-appropriate branching, imperfect natural shapes and realistic fine detail. Neutral diffuse illumination for PBR albedo, restrained natural mid-green foliage, muted brown twigs, no dramatic lighting or cast shadow. These are original isolated botanical cutouts, NOT whole trees, no pot, no landscape, no lettering, no logos, no grid lines, no border, NO solid background, NO fake checkerboard, no black/white halo. Preserve semi-transparent antialiased leaf/needle edges and transparent gaps through the foliage. The background must be genuinely transparent, with an alpha channel.
prompts.bark: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original seamless repeating tree bark PBR albedo material. Produce one square 1024x1024 texture tile showing Pacific Northwest mature tree bark: gray-brown Douglas-fir / western redcedar-inspired vertical fibrous ridges, irregular narrow fissures, layered weathered plates, occasional warm cinnamon fibers, subtly varied fine grain. Orthographic close-up of surface only, bark fully covering the entire square, no cylindrical tree silhouette or perspective. Truly seamless tileable left to right and top to bottom; fine-scale irregular detail continues across opposite edges without a visible seam. Flat neutral diffuse illumination, no directional highlights, no baked hard shadows, no vignette, no depth-of-field blur. Natural moderate contrast, usable as albedo on branching tree trunks. No leaves, moss patches, roots, labels, text, logos, frame, or border. Original material, not a photograph copied from another source.
